name: @zendfi/appkit
description: Build ZApps: Sign in with Zend, payments, money links and interactions.

scripts.site:
npm run build && rm -rf site && mkdir -p site/sdk && cp dist/index.js site/sdk/ && cp -r examples/coinflip site/coinflip && cp -r examples/.well-known site/.well-known && printf '/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors https://app.usezend.app
/.well-known/*
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
' > site/_headers
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run site && npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name zapps-examples --branch main
